sql:
SELECT
              c.company_name
            FROM
              fct_posting AS p
            JOIN
              dim_company AS c
            ON
              p.company_key = c.company_key
            WHERE
              p.family = 'Data Science'
              AND p.remote_us = TRUE
            GROUP BY
              c.company_name
            ORDER BY
              count(*) DESC
            LIMIT 1
